text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"control of sentence chaining and transitions","quality":"discursive control","description":"This captures the ability to sustain a line of argument across paragraphs with clearer progression and more coherent connection between ideas."},{"evidence":"more varied sentence openings and syntax","quality":"syntactic variety","description":"This captures using a wider range of sentence patterns rather than repeating the same simple declarative structures."},{"evidence":"phrases like 'rose colored glasses' and 'dealers choice'","quality":"idiomatic expression","description":"This captures more natural, native-like phrase choice and figurative language that gives the writing a more fluent voice."},{"evidence":"fewer basic agreement slips than A's 'people have a good attitudes'","quality":"grammatical control","description":"This captures stronger control over core grammar such as agreement, articles, and verb forms, even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"argument framed with counterclaims such as 'it doesn't guarantee anything'","quality":"argumentative development","description":"This captures the ability to acknowledge and extend a position with qualification rather than relying mainly on repeated assertions."}]}
